_title: The arc's own name, no number: the player is told the 回 (book.json via the scenes' `hui`, rules/hui.mjs); this stands only where a chapter has no 回.

summary.zh: 北上冀州。邺城年年给河伯娶妇；你把巫祝「送去报信」，漳水立了起来，冰夷的两条龙试了那个不跪的人。破开洛书之封，第一鼎归来——柳树底下，站着太一宫的赵昂。
summary.en: North into Ji. Every year Ye gives the River Lord a bride; you "send the shaman to take word", the Zhang stands up, and Bingyi's two dragons test the one who would not kneel. The Luo seal breaks, the first cauldron comes home — and under the willow stands Zhao Ang of the Taiyi Palace.

intro.zh: 筑基第二天夜里，观主摊开一张舆图：冀州，邺城，漳水边上，有件怪事——每年，都有人给河伯娶媳妇。
intro.en: The night after your Foundation, the abbot unrolls a map: Ji, the city of Ye, on the Zhang — something strange: every year, somebody marries the River Lord a wife.

mystery.zh: 邺城年年送下水的新娘，嫁的是谁？
mystery.en: Whom do the brides Ye sends into the water really marry?

_gate: No breakthrough here since 2026-09-30: the Foundation is laid on the 沉鼎观 cliff in 第九回 (00-zhuji, gate 1); 冀 gives the first 鼎, 银月's second tail and her first memory.

did.zh: 漳水立起的那一天，满岸的人都跪了，你没有跪
did.en: The day the Zhang stood up, the whole bank knelt, and you did not

did.zh: 冰夷的两条龙试过了你
第一口鼎，跟着你出了水
did.en: and the first cauldron came up out of the water with you

teaser.zh: 却说冀州鼎出水的消息，跑得比漳水还快。不出一月，太一宫便有人上了沉鼎山，说是来「借鼎」；观主为难了三天。第三天夜里，沈小满背起爷爷那张打了补丁的弓，悄悄下了山——从此是个散修。他走到山脚，身后有人喘着气追上来：「利息还没还完，想跑？」要知后事如何，且听卷二分解。
teaser.en: Word that the Ji cauldron had come out of the water ran faster than the Zhang. Within a month men of the Taiyi Palace climbed the Sunken Cauldron Mountain, come, they said, to "borrow" it; the abbot was at a loss for three days. On the third night Shen Xiaoman shouldered his grandfather's patched bow and slipped down the mountain — a wandering cultivator from then on. At the foot of the hill someone came panting after him: "The interest isn't paid yet — running off?" What came next, Volume Two will tell.
